summary: Iteration 203: short retest of the 3 fixes from iteration 202. All pass. BACKEND: new unit and live suite test_app_connect_iter203.py passes 22/22. It monkeypatches _call/_as_student/website_mocks/time, so it uses no real accounts and writes nothing to the DB. _grant returns 503 with BUSY_ACCOUNT for 200 answers shaped {}, token only, expires_at only, expires_at None, expires_at garbage, a list, or a string. mission_me returns 503 for {}, no code, a list, a string or an int. The valid answers still work (the link ends with /j/AB2CDEF). _send_website_mocks: the first call queries and sends; within 30 s there is no DB query; an unchanged list within 10 min is not re-sent and sent_at is kept across rechecks; it re-sends after more than 600 s; a changed list is sent at once; an empty list is never sent but is still throttled. Live, signed out: GET /api/mission/me 401, GET /api/dream 401, /api/j/AB2CDEF 302 to https://jeelive-mobile.emergent.host/api/j/AB2CDEF, POST /api/rank/bitsat {score:280} 200. FRONTEND: BITSAT 280 history bars follow their inline % of a 58px track. Card 0: 95%=55.1px, 98%=56.8, 100%=58.0, 91%=52.8. Cards 1 and 2 were also correct, and missing years show a 6% stub with '—'. At 320px, dream-exam (empty and 3-JEE mocks), cp-exam and tm-exam: scrollWidth 260 == clientWidth 260, document width 320, no button overflows, all buttons 44px tall, font 12px; 'JEE Main 3/5' and 'COMEDK 0/5' wrap to 2 lines and stay readable. At 390px all are unchanged: 13px font, 44px tall, no overflow.

minor.issue: When the send to the app server fails (non-200, e.g. 422), nothing is remembered. Every GET /api/dream then runs the Mongo query and POSTs again with no 30 s throttle. Only matters if the app server keeps rejecting.
When a student's website mock list becomes empty after having mocks, nothing is sent, so the app server keeps the old mocks. Probably by design (the POST replaces by same id); noted only.
Type checking is shallow: token=None or '' and code=None are accepted. This gives an Authorization header with no token, or a link ending in '/None'. Only if the app server sends nulls.

issues: Bars are scaled from 0, so cutoffs in the 268-301 range all look 90-100% tall and the year-to-year differences are hard to see. Optional: scale from a baseline such as min-10.

action_items: Optional: in _send_website_mocks, remember checked_at even when the send fails, so it backs off.
Optional: check that token/code are non-empty strings.
critical_code_review_comments: app_connect.py: `import json` inside _send_website_mocks should be a top-level import.
Logic of MOCK_RECHECK/MOCK_RESEND is correct for first call, empty list, unchanged within 10 min, and changed list (verified by unit tests).
